title: Experiment 8 — Certificate quality (unsat core + repair)
question: Are the emitted contradiction proofs and repairs valid and minimal?

Example certificate.statements: The patient has held private insurance for years. | The data were recorded in the hospital system. | chemotherapy occurred before discharge. | discharge occurred before diagnosis. | The patient was seen in the outpatient clinic. | diagnosis occurred before chemotherapy.

notes: Every flagged contradiction ships with a checkable proof (unsat core) and a minimal repair — artifacts no score-only detector provides.
